svg.title: emeans: from raw points to clusters in a few passes
svg.desc: Three pictures. Left, labelled x: unlabelled points in three groups. Middle, labelled emeans(x, k = 3): one mini-batch of points is highlighted while each centroid's path spirals into the middle of its group. Right, labelled predict(fit, new): the points coloured by cluster with a ringed centre in each, and two new points joined by dashed lines to their nearest centre.
